newsitem.title: USA: Security Capital files debt, equity shelf.
newsitem.headline: Security Capital files debt, equity shelf.

text.p: Security Capital Pacific Trust filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $300 million of debt securities, preferred shares of beneficial interest and common stock of beneficial interest.

The El Paso, Texas-based real estate investment trust said there are an additional $120 million of debt securities and preferred shares of beneficial interest registered under a previous registration statement.

Proceeds from the sale of the newly registered securities will be used to develop and acquire additional multifamily communities, to repay certain outstanding debt and for working capital, the company said.
The company did not name any underwriters for the offering.
